blocking_prerequisites: Hepta has no compatible install-context bundled-resource resolver
the upstream change spans session, tool dispatch, feature, install, protocol, runtime, and packaging authority

define a versioned process handshake and session-bound nested-tool identity

route every nested tool call through the existing Hepta permission and host-tool protection registry

no upstream intake may mutate preference, memory authority, release gates, or live runtime
decision: keep source_progress_release_blocked; complete prerequisites in isolated auditable slices rather than importing incompatible upstream execution trees
